text_block_list.text:
One day in the Trainer's Office, Biwa 
Hayahide had a smile on her face as she 
read through fan letters.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
‘The brilliant intellect shining behind 
your glasses is wonderful.’

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"I was captivated by your intelligent 
running"—was it?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"I only started wearing glasses because of 
my poor eyesight, but—"
choice_data_list:
That's what the fans find so charming 
about you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Recognizing the gap between one's 
self-perception and how others see them 
should prove useful for self-branding as 
well."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
How you are perceived, and what is 
expected of you... Fan letters should help 
you understand that.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
As someone standing on the main stage, in 
order to earn the support of all the fans—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I must always be conscious of how I 
present myself and continue to polish my 
unique qualities.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
For the time being... Shall we start by 
cleaning our glasses?

Biwa Hayahide touched her glasses as she 
spoke, looking somewhat proud of herself.
